name: Bay Area Crisis Nursery - BACN Boutique
description: Free clothing, shoes, books, toys, children's furniture, and baby equipment for families; includes parent clothing and hygiene items
fullDescription: BACN Boutique provides free clothing, shoes, children's furniture, toys, and essential items for families. It is located in the Bay Area Crisis Nursery lobby in Concord and is open to the public.
whatTheyOffer:
- Free clothing and shoes for children and parents
- Children's furniture, books, and toys
- Baby items for expecting parents: clothing, blankets, bottles, strollers, and equipment
- Hygiene products for parents
- Staff can help find items you don't see
- Everything is free
howToGetIt:
1. Visit the Boutique in the Nursery lobby (office hours Mon-Fri 9am-5pm)
2. Open to the public at no cost
3. Browse available items
4. Ask Nursery staff if you need something you don't see
5. Take items home at no cost
6. Call ahead to order food and diapers to pick up at the same visit
keywords: BACN Boutique, free clothing, free shoes, baby equipment, maternity, Concord, family supplies, Crisis Nursery
